mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.7% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede a decline in equity valuations due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.7%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 205.0 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases, or the interaction term's Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
